summaries.Romania: Romania faces political gridlock as PM-designate Siegfried Mureșan struggles to secure the 233 votes needed for government formation, while Fitch warns of potential sovereign downgrade if the crisis extends. President Nicușor Dan inaugurates infrastructure projects and participates in regional security initiatives amid broader concerns about fiscal stability and defense spending.
summaries.Healthcare: Ultragenyx's gene therapy becomes the first FDA-approved treatment for Sanfilippo syndrome, while CMS expands its outcomes-based payment model to cover heart failure, COPD, and substance use disorders starting spring 2027. Healthcare innovation accelerates through AI-powered care coordination and wearable integration, though hospital operating margins remain under pressure.
summaries.Tech: Apple launches iPhone 18 Pro with variable aperture camera and the foldable iPhone Duo arriving in October, while iOS 27 brings expanded Apple Intelligence features across 30+ new languages. AI safety concerns intensify as researchers demonstrate vulnerabilities in frontier models, and regulatory pressure mounts with California proposing AI kill switches and India forcing data-sharing requirements on caller-ID apps.

items.title: Siegfried Mureşan nu ia în calcul să-și depună mandatul, dacă nu obține voturile pentru învestirea unui guvern
items.snippet: Premierul desemnat Siegfried Mureşan a anunţat, vineri seară, la Digi24, că nu ia în calcul să-şi depună mandatul, dacă la finalul perioadei în care trebuie să prezinte Cabinetul va constata că nu are voturile necesare.
items.line: PM-designate Mureșan confirms he won't resign if lacking votes, setting stage for Romania's government formation outcome to unfold without last-minute tactics.

items.title: Fitch avertizează România: Riscul retrogradării la „junk” crește dacă se prelungește criza politică
items.snippet: România este într-o cursă contracronometru pentru a evita retrogradarea la categoria „junk” (n.r. nerecomandat pentru investiţii), în contextul în care o criză politică prelungită pune în pericol credibilitatea fiscală, a declarat Malgorzata Krzywicka, analistă la agenţia de evaluare financiară Fitc
items.line: Fitch's junk-status warning creates urgent fiscal pressure on Romania to resolve its political crisis and stabilize macroeconomic credibility within months.

items.title: Ultragenyx Gene Therapy Is First Approved Treatment for Rare Neuro Disease Sanfilippo
items.snippet:
Ultragenyx Pharmaceutical’s Fayuvi is now the first FDA-approved therapy for the underlying cause of Sanfilippo syndrome type A, an ultra-rare inherited neurological disorder. It’s the second approved gene therapy for Ultragenyx, which specializes in rare disease medicines. 
The post Ultragenyx Gene
items.line: Ultragenyx's Fayuvi becomes first FDA-approved gene therapy targeting Sanfilippo syndrome's underlying cause, expanding treatment options for ultra-rare neurological disorders.

items.title: CMS Broadens ACCESS Model to New Chronic Conditions
items.snippet: CMS will expand its ACCESS model starting in spring 2027 to cover heart failure, COPD, substance use disorders and tobacco cessation. items.line: CMS expands ACCESS model to cover heart failure, COPD, and substance use disorders, broadening outcomes-based payment incentives to three-quarters of Medicare beneficiaries by spring 2027.

items.title: Oura, Counsel Health join CMS ACCESS model to test whether wearables and AI can improve chronic care at scale
